formative_worksheets.title: The Predict and Test Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (10 minutes) to confirm D2.1 (likelihood) and the predict-then-test order before extending into D2.2.
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check that probes whether the child can use likelihood vocabulary AND make a prediction BEFORE testing. Catches predict-after issues before the capstone.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can name likelihoods and make a prediction.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can name likelihoods and make a prediction.
header.character_watermark: Lucky Lou the Loon in the top-right corner with a clipboard. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: Name 3 events as IMPOSSIBLE, POSSIBLE, or CERTAIN.
prompts.visual_layout: Three event lines stacked. Each has the event sentence and 3 letter circles I/P/C to circle.

image_placeholders.description: Three event rows for a Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. Each row ~5in × 0.8in. Events: 'A cow flies' (IMPOSSIBLE), 'It rains today' (POSSIBLE), 'The day ends' (CERTAIN). Each row has the event on the left and three letter circles I/P/C on the right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_EVENTS at Prompt 1: instructions ask the child to circle the likelihood. Keywords name the categories.

prompts.prompt: Predict 3 coin flips. Then ask the teacher to flip and tell you the result.

image_placeholders.description: A 2-column 3-row prediction table for a Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. Header: 'Predict' and 'Result'. 3 rows for H/T entries. Each cell ~1in × 0.8in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_COINS at Prompt 2: instructions ask the child to predict and test coin flips. Keywords name the columns.

prompts.answer_key: Any 3 H/T predictions in the Predict column with corresponding actual outcomes in the Result column. Predictions and results may differ.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling about likelihood and predictions? Circle the face.
prompts.visual_layout: Three faces in a row: smile, neutral, frown. Below each: 'I got it!', 'Almost!', 'Need help!'.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a horizontal row for a Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. Smile, neutral, frown. Each ~1.5in across with a label below.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: instructions ask the child to circle their feeling. Keywords name the visual.

prompts.answer_key: Open. Use this self-rating alongside Prompts 1 and 2.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child. Score guide: Q1 perfect + predict-before-test in Q2 + 'I got it' = ready. Q1 wrong = re-loop on the 3 likelihood terms. Q2 with results filled before predictions = re-loop on order.

reflection_sheet.title: My Likelihood Reflection
reflection_sheet.purpose: End-of-unit metacognition. Children look back at their week of likelihood detective work.
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Lucky and Mae in the top-right corner with a Junior Likelihood Detective certificate. Small (~1.5in combined). References blueprint.recurring_characters.
